title: Joel Polanco — Senior Product Manager
description: Joel Polanco is a senior product manager in Intel's Data Center and AI Group, writing about product management and coaching technical founders on customer discovery.
ogDescription: Senior product manager in Intel's Data Center and AI Group. Writing about product management and coaching technical founders on customer discovery.

hero.name: Joel Polanco
body: I'm a **senior product manager** who loves to solve hard problems, meet new people, and have some fun along the way. I'm a big fan of slash careers and pursuing one's passions through side bets.
Currently, I've been focused on transitioning my org to an **AI-first mindset** and identifying ways to transform the business through AI tools.

facts.value: Intel, Data Center and AI Group

sections.heading: Background
body: I started out my career as a semiconductor fab process engineer. I'm an engineer at heart but have a **passion for business and technology**.

After I earned my MBA, I moved into several analyst roles before making a home in product management. I'm most comfortable when I'm working with engineers developing scalable solutions to customer problems.

image.alt: Joel Polanco as a semiconductor fab process engineer

sections.heading: Current Role
sections.kicker: Intel, Data Center and AI Group
body: I'm a product manager in the Data Center and AI Group at Intel, working on data center computing.
Most of my attention right now goes to moving my organization to an AI-first way of working: finding where AI tools genuinely change how the business runs, and being honest about where they don't.
Outside of Intel I coach future founders on **customer discovery**, and spend my time on personal finance, investing, reading and writing.

items.quote: Our company faced an overwhelming amount of information. From the customer discovery plan to the detailed methods of analysis, Joel's expertise was evident every step of the way.
items.name: Marie Eric

items.quote: Joel's guidance through this process was incredible. We worked together to iterate on our customer segments, our business model, and ultimately funding direction. I wouldn't have been able to do any of this without Joel.
items.name: Keith Gregorzyk Ph.D.

items.quote: Joel has been an amazing coach for our start-ups! He has helped many of our startups think through the process of connecting product value to attainable first market segments.
items.name: Mike Ducker
